entries.title: Habakkuk 3:3

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:5

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:6
segments: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways [are] everlasting.

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:7

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:8
segments: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? [was] thine anger against the rivers? [was] thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses [and] thy chariots of salvation? {of...: or, were salvation?}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:9
segments: Thy bow was made quite naked, [according] to the oaths of the tribes, [even thy] word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers. {earth...: or, rivers of the earth}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:10
segments: The mountains saw thee, [and] they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, [and] lifted up his hands on high.

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:11
segments: The sun [and] moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, [and] at the shining of thy glittering spear. {at the light...: or, thine arrows walked in the light}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:12
segments: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:13
segments: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, [even] for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah. {by...: Heb. making naked}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:14
segments: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing [was] as to devour the poor secretly. {came...: Heb. were tempestuous}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:15
segments: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, [through] the heap of great waters. {heap: or, mud}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:16
segments: ¶When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops. {invade...: or, cut them in pieces}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:17
segments: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither [shall] fruit [be] in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and [there shall be] no herd in the stalls: {fall: Heb. lie}

entries.title: Habakkuk 3:18
segments: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
